details: This package is an empty placeholder published under a name that impersonates the legitimate `baileys` WhatsApp library — a combosquat that keeps the real name intact and adds a prefix. The published tarball contains only a package.json and a README (336 bytes total): no JavaScript, no lifecycle hooks, no dependencies, no bin entries, and no network indicators. The package's own description and README describe it as a "temporary package placeholder for staged publishing" / "temporary holding version" awaiting a staged release. No executable behaviour is present in this version; the analysis is metadata-only and no IOCs were observed.
